text:
maya: heads up — rough proposal for rollout slice alerting + soft-rollback logic. dropped a quick mock and a PromQL sketch here: https://redwood.fake/s/rollout-slice-mock :eyes:

samir: looked — interesting. can you spell out the "divergence score" math?

maya: divergence = KL(base || canary) over top-token distribution + weighted latency delta (p50). weights are currently 0.7 KL / 0.3 latency, then normalized to 0-100. threshold = 12 as a starting point for flagging. open to suggestions.

alex: are we computing KL on model token probs or on embeddings? token probs are more direct but heavier.

maya: token probs (logits -> softmax) from runtime telemetry. we already emit sampled logits for evals so we can reuse that path. cost is the main concern — see sampling cap below.

samir: we should gate it in Telemetry via a per-rollout per-slice cap: "max-samples-per-minute" to keep egress/storage bounded. suggest 200rpm per slice as default. also we need an efficient incremental reducer so we don't recompute raw logs for every alert eval.

maya: proposal config (sketch):
```
rollout:
  id: r-123
  slices:
    - name: mobile-ios
      sample_rate: 0.02
      monitoring:
        divergence_threshold: 12
        window: 5m
        sample_cap_per_min: 200
  traffic:
    ramp:
      step: 10%
      interval: 5m
      max_step_delta: 15%
      soft_rollback: true
```

kevin: console UX idea: add a "slice explorer" panel — small multiples for each slice showing p50 latency, divergence sparkline, error rate. click through on a high divergence tile to see exemplar prompts + traces. reuse the heatmap slot from the rollout page.

alex: alerting modes: +1 for two distinct actions — "soft-rollback" (auto adjust traffic back to previous step) and "notify-and-hold" (stop ramp and page on-call). soft-rollback must have a cooldown TTL to avoid thrash. recommend 10m cooldown and require sustained breach for > window*2 before triggering auto action.

maya: good call. will add cooldown + sustained-window requirement to the policy. also add a circuit-breaker that only allows N auto-rollback events per 24h.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout r-123 step to 30% for slice mobile-ios at 1850012600

maya: ack. adding action items: 1) telemetry sampling cap ticket, 2) divergence function unit tests + benchmarks, 3) console mock for slice explorer + tiles, 4) alert policy enum (soft rollback / notify / hold). @samir can you take telemetry sampling? @kevin can you mock the tiles?

samir: :thumbsup: I'll own telemetry sampling. quick question — when we change weights (KL vs latency) how do we backfill past divergence so historical charts remain comparable? store raw summaries?

maya: we store per-minute summaries: histograms for latency + top-N token diffs counts. backfill will recompute from those summaries. if we change the formula we'll recompute divergence over stored summaries and mark the rollout timeline as "recomputed" so UX shows versioning. I'll add storage spec to the ticket.

kevin: will mock tiles and include an expand-to-traces action. plan to show a tiny list of exemplar prompts that drove the divergence so PMs can triage quickly.

maya: thanks all — I'll spin up PRs for telemetry cap and the alerting enum. saving notes here before I file so we have a clear spec.
